name: Patchouli's Magical Talisman
justification: Neat greedy: fusing even+odd is always 1 op; only the all-even case needs thought.
solution_sketch: If any odd exists, fuse each even with an odd: answer = #evens. If all even, first halve the element with the fewest trailing zero bits k until odd (k ops), then answer = k + (n-1).
